options.name: War of hegemony loser
options.desc: Graonia sided with Źelia during the Second war of Hegemony and despite their sacrifices on the Leukian and Kachakonyan fronts, was defeated and lost most of her colonies and splendor.

options.name: Graonian resurgence
options.desc: With bolstered army, economy and regional alliances the country's international standing has increased.

options.name: Revived regional power
options.desc: With an outstanding increase in economic and military power the country has become a prominent candidate for a regional leader.
